description.en: Specifies whether to enable asynchronous query.

description.zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

description.zh: 作业最晚提交时间。格式为Unix时间戳，表示从1970-01-01T00:00:00Z起所经过的秒数。
description.en: The latest time when a job is submitted. The value is a UNIX timestamp, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

description.zh: 作业最早提交时间。格式为Unix时间戳，表示从1970-01-01T00:00:00Z起所经过的秒数。
description.en: The earliest time when a job is submitted. The value is a UNIX timestamp, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

description.zh:
按照作业执行时间进行排序。取值范围：

- asc：升序。

- desc：降序。
description.en:
The order in which jobs are sorted based on the execution time. Valid values:

*   asc: ascending order
*   desc: descending order

description.zh: 作业名称。支持模糊查询。
description.en: The name of the job. Fuzzy search is supported.

description.zh:
作业状态。取值范围：

- all：所有状态。

- finished：已完成。

- notfinish：未完成。

默认值：all。
description.en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

*   all
*   finished
*   notfinish

Default value: all.

description.zh: 执行作业的计算节点列表信息。
description.en: The information about the computing nodes that are used to run the job.

description.zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1。
description.en:
The page number to return.

Pages start from 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

description.zh:
按照作业排队时间进行排序。取值范围：

- asc：升序。

- desc：降序。
description.en:
The order in which jobs are sorted based on the time when they queue. Valid values:

*   asc: ascending order
*   desc: descending order

description.zh: 执行作业的队列列表信息。
description.en: The information about the queues in which the job is run.

description.zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用[ListRegions](~~188593~~)查询可以使用E-HPC的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [ListRegions](~~188593~~) operation to query the list of regions where E-HPC is supported.

description.zh:
按照作业提交时间进行排序。取值范围：

- asc：升序。

- desc：降序。
description.en:
The order in which jobs are sorted based on the time when they are submitted. Valid values:

*   asc: ascending order
*   desc: descending order

description.zh: 执行作业的用户列表信息。
description.en: The users that run the job.
